question: Which chess piece moves straight ahead but attacks cornerwise?A. Knight B.RookC.BishopD.Pawn (RRB NTPC Tier I (02/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: C
D
A
B
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pawn

Explanation:
In chess, the pawn is the smallest piece. It moves only straight ahead one square (or two on its first move) but attacks diagonally one square forward left or right. Pawns cannot move backward. When a pawn reaches the opposite end of the board, it can be promoted to any other piece (except a pawn), usually a queen. Pawns also have the special capture rule called en passant. Other pieces: knight moves in an L-shape, rook moves in straight lines horizontally or vertically, and bishop moves diagonally. Therefore, the pawn is the only piece that moves straight but attacks diagonally.
